Nina (product): Quick sync request  Helix wants a private-deploy plan: customer-managed networking, predictable upgrade path, and minimal IP churn. They want draft acceptance tests by EOW.
Omar (eng-runtime): We should split: M1 = managed peering + DNS handoff + canary API; M2 = IP continuity (VIP/floating) + offline installer. M1 est 2-3w, M2 est 5-7w.
Lulu (field): Helix NetOps will only accept <1min disruption. They prefer BGP-based VIP swaps but would accept a controlled DNS TTL approach if we can prove it. KMS audit logs required.
Sam (solutions): Suggest a "controlled-swap" runbook: mirror traffic, warm caches, then flip VIP. We'll supply a test harness and a verification checklist. Example cmd: `curl -H "Host: helix-canary" https://private.helix/health`.
Omar (eng-runtime): Implementation note: controlled-swap needs sequence support in control plane and a feature flag `vip_swap: controlled|immediate`. Also need installer change to allow customer-specified route tables. I'll RFC it.
Nina (product): Proposed: ship M1 as Q3 deliverable (peering, DNS handoff automation, canary + rollback playbook, KMS logs). Defer M2 (IP continuity + airgap/installer polish) to Q4. Align SLA wording with legal.
Lulu (field): Helix will accept M1 if we deliver: NetOps handoff doc, scripted verification steps, and a staging run they can run. I'll collect exact SLA numbers.
pm-bot: Created draft: /docs/private-deploys/helix-handshake-draft.md (owner: Sam). Reviewers: Omar, Lulu.
Nina (product): Action items: Sam to drop runbook + harness by Tue, Omar to open RFC for `vip_swap` and installer flags by Thu, Lulu to confirm SLA thresholds by Wed. We'll present this at Friday steering. :white_check_mark:
